scope: Actual907 to combined release corpus delta: immutable existing cards, seven authored retrieval catalogs, bounded context8 historical gap checks, twelve frozen AIK development cases, informed manual recovery, candidate/holdout isolation and focused knowledge tests; no scientific source promotion or performance claims.

implementation.procedure: Review actual knowledge/file/index implementation, unchanged ranking function ASTs, evaluator and replay scripts; run both baseline and candidate runtime paths.
implementation.acceptance: Changes are limited to authorized document write guard and additive corpus metadata; retrieval ranking semantics and budgets remain unchanged.

reference_boundary.procedure: Compare actual pinned907 baseline corpus and runtime; verify candidate exclusions and unchanged fulltext/strong dependency refs; preserve no-hit and budget failures.
reference_boundary.acceptance: No per-query recall/rank/no-hit regressions caused by added cards; candidate remains blocked by normal get/search/index.

data_integrity.procedure: Bind code, catalogs, queries, gold, complete raw outputs, command exit statuses, original card hashes and snapshots before/after.
data_integrity.acceptance: No changed gold, omitted failed cases, baseline card mutation, holdout release or dependency drift.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Independently recompute means and counts from raw expected/actual/context IDs; distinguish rawTop3 and bounded context recall.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Finite metrics in valid range and exact same denominators; reported counts match raw rows.

measurement_validity.procedure: Check authored development/regression labels, unchanged default limits, separate context8 and manually informed recovery; do not make timing claims.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Results are scoped to observed retrieval/function contracts and known failures remain explicit; timings not used for claims.

reproducibility.procedure: Review pinned commands, Python/SQLite environment and actual executed logs; final reviewer may rerun an existing query per backend and verify hashes.
reproducibility.acceptance: Dependencies stable; focused tests passed; final independent reviewer can identify and verify exact artifacts without treating producer pass JSON as authority.
